只通过 typed DCC-MCP，在独立且确认空场景的 Houdini 宿主制:
Using only typed DCC-MCP, create a celadon ringed ceramic vessel in a separate Houdini host confirmed to contain an empty scene. Do not modify scenes belonging to other tasks or directly run Houdini asset-creation scripts. Create a 51-point radius/height profile that continuously defines the base, ringed outer wall, shoulder, rim and inner wall, then revolve it around the Y axis in 144 segments. Add two Subdivide levels and vertex normals. Retain the complete editable SOP chain.

Use a Principled Shader with celadon-green basecolor=[0.035,0.21,0.18], disable point colors, and set roughness=0.30, coat=0.35 and coatrough=0.24. Set the floor to basecolor=[0.46,0.40,0.32] and roughness=0.65; both the floor's top surface and the model's lowest point must be at y=0. Use no external textures. Set up a 90 mm lens and three grid softboxes, keeping the full opening, shoulder rings and base contact shadow visible.

First save and render an actual intermediate image. Make limited lighting and composition adjustments based on the image, then produce an actual 1200×1500 Mantra hero image with PBR Ray Tracing, 4×4 pixel samples and a maximum of 16 secondary rays. Use `$HIP/hero.png` for the output, save the project, wait for the isolated rendering job to finish and check the file. Then reopen the project and read back geometry counts, materials, camera and render path.

Use `--require-gateway` and a stable `--agent-session-id` for all formal CLI calls. Begin with inventory, scoped search and load-skill/describe, then call tools according to their actual schemas. Record actual tool names, requests/responses and failures; do not substitute a tool's applied field for checking the actual file dimensions.
